sections.title: Sound of letter e
paragraphs: The name of this letter is (e) /e/. Its main sound appears in (essere) /ˈɛs.se.re/, which means to be. A vowel is a sound made with open air and no touch in the mouth. This letter has two different sounds.

sections.title: How to say e
paragraphs: For the first sound, lift your tongue high and spread your lips wide. For the second sound, drop your jaw slightly lower and relax your lips. Both sounds are voiced. A voiced sound makes your vocal cords shake. Touch your throat to feel the strong hum.

sections.title: Spelling of letter e
paragraphs: This letter makes its close sound in stressed or unstressed positions, as in (mela) /ˈme.la/ and (vedere) /veˈde.re/. A stressed beat sounds louder and longer. It makes its open sound only in stressed syllables, as in (bello) /ˈbɛl.lo/ and (è) /ɛ/.

sections.title: Mistakes to avoid with e
paragraphs: Do not turn this letter into a diphthong. A diphthong glides from one vowel to another. Keep the sound steady, unlike the vowel in say. Do not swallow the letter at the end of a word like a weak vowel in sofa. Keep your mouth firm and clear.
